title: How To Build A Game From 0
author: visnefe
selftext:
How Do You Plan, How Do You Even Start  
Every Time ı Start All İdeas Attack Me  
Then ı Feel Like ı Did Not Start From The Right Place etc

How Do You Do İt

comments.author: Substantial_Fish6717
comments.body: How do you write like this?

comments.author: soloh4cker
comments.body: The simple answer is explain the idea to AI in prompts and wait for the result... But this might be not the right answer for you because first you have to explain what and how you are currently doing so that we can maybe spot the mistake and explain you what you need to improve!

comments.author: Duneagames
comments.body:
tell it your dreams. use a free speech-to-text like openwhispr. 

when I start a project, i talk for 15 minutes sometimes, just emptying my brain. the more thorough you are, the better the project will start.

replies.author: visnefe
replies.body: So, how would you define Step 1? Where do you usually start?

replies.author: Ill-Past4609
replies.body: Yeah he had a point if you can’t explain to use your plan use the recorder on Claude app or use your microphone 🎤 in the pc and explain your entire plan tell it you don’t know how to do anything and you want to create a GDD and have a plan for everything if you don’t know how to draw or make animations make sure you let it know that also so you can create your own art pipeline

comments.author: Heath_co
comments.body:
You need to use the desktop claude app if you don't already.

Begin with an idea. Ask the AI to make that idea.

It almost certainly won't be good enough, but then you can ask the AI for ways to improve it to better match your vision.

Continuously work on the game until you have an established workflow and can systematically build the game.

comments.author: BinniesPurp
comments.body:
Game design document, then cut out like 90% of the stuff in the examples because it's ment for communication in teams more than anything, and keep the structure parts of it 

(And then I use an LLM to act as my HR department to give me weekly timetables and stop me from slacking lol)

comments.author: samcripp
comments.body:
\-Define the vision.

"I want my game to be a fighter, based in Russia, and all protagonist will fight using their hair"

\-Develop a simple demo to test the idea.

\-Refine the demo  
Once you have a working demo, something that feels perfect for what you want, you then take those mechanism and extend them.

\-Fighter game extension  
We need fighters, menus, basic multiplayer and networking, etc, etc.

\-Fighter game refinement

\-Fighter game completion

No one creates a game in one prompt. As far as agentic work. Before you start anything make sure you setup "a game studio" A director agent with sub agents that own task employees would own in a game studio, with your director being the source of truth and the steward of your vision.

comments.author: Available-March1619
comments.body:
Take all your ideas, jam ALL of them into your brain, then, go jump in a Lake any time of day….  
Swim. Breathe. Come up to surface, Look at the sky. Thank your parents for teaching you how to swim. Then…  
The first one to your mind from there is where to start.  
Is it the ‘right one’ no. But gives you a Path to start.
